findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key in Terraform configuration. These credentials can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, Lambda configuration access, or runtime compromise; use the execution role or a managed secret instead.
The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life Lambda runtime that no longer receives security fixes, increasing exposure to known and unpatched runtime vulnerabilities.
